Machine Learning in Predicting Printable Biomaterial Formulations for Direct Ink Writing

High AI for Bioprinting openalex Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Hongyi Chen, Yuanchang Liu, Stavroula Balabani, Ryuji Hirayama, Jie Huang Research 2023-01-01 10.34133/research.0197
单位: Department of Computer Science, University College London, London, UK
通讯: Hongyi Chen @ Department of Computer Science, University College London, London, UK
相关性: 该论文将机器学习用于预测生物墨水可打印性，直接应用于生物打印的预处理阶段，与你的AI生物打印方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not cover post-printing quality control or bioprinting process control; it focuses solely on pre-printing ink formulation prediction.
动机· 消除墨水开发中的试错，节省时间和资源
方法· 用决策树、随机森林和深度学习预测生物墨水可打印性
结果· 随机森林准确率最高(88.1%)，深度学习召回率最高(87.3%)
验证· 通过3D打印210种配方并评估可打印性
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To replace trial-and-error ink development with predictive models for efficient biomaterial formulation.
Method· Applied decision tree, random forest, and deep learning algorithms to predict printability of biomaterial inks based on their composition.
Result· Random forest achieved highest accuracy (88.1%) and precision (90.6%), while deep learning exhibited the best recall (87.3%).
Validation· Experimental validation by 3D printing 210 formulations and assessing their printability.

High AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Antoine Vautrin, Jensen Aw, Ed Attenborough, Peter Varga Frontiers in bioengineering and biotechnology 2023-01-01 10.3389/fbioe.2023.1240125
单位: AO Research Institute Davos, Davos, Switzerland.; Graduate School for Cellular and Biomedical Sciences, University of Bern, Bern, Switzerland.
通讯: Peter Varga @ AO Research Institute Davos, Davos, Switzerland. [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接使用打印后多孔钛牙种植体进行疲劳实验与有限元验证，完全契合用户对LPBF多孔结构、应力遮挡匹配与疲劳力学评价的研究方向。
边界: It covers porous dental implant fatigue with FE validation, but does not address hip implant stress shielding or bone-implant interface micromotion at hip scale.
动机· 多孔牙种植体疲劳强度预测困难，加速验证流程。
方法· 结合单调与疲劳实验、有限元模拟及微CT扫描校准，建立疲劳寿命预测流程。
结果· 归一化疲劳极限为极限载荷10%；考虑打印几何偏差可降低预测误差至8%。
验证· 利用3D打印Ti6Al4V样品进行单调与疲劳测试，以微CT几何修正提高模拟精度。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Porous dental implants risk fatigue failure; experimental testing is costly, so validated simulations are needed.
Method· A numerical workflow was developed by linking endurance limit to monotonic load via experiments and calibrating FE models with as-designed, micro-CT, or porosity-adjusted geometry.
Result· The normalized endurance limit was 10% of ultimate load; using porosity-adjusted geometry reduced prediction error to 8%.
Validation· Monotonic and fatigue tests on LPBF Ti samples were used to calibrate and validate FE predictions against experimental loads.

边界: It lacks detailed quantification of micromotion at the bone-implant interface and does not include patient-specific geometry or boundary conditions.
动机· 减少应力遮挡以防止骨溶解和假体松动

Motivation· To minimize stress shielding after hip replacement, which is a major cause of aseptic loosening.

Result· The porous implant reduced stress shielding by 70% and bone resorption by 60% compared to a solid implant, with safety factors above 2 under all daily activities.
Validation· Validation involved mechanical testing (compression, fatigue) and finite element simulations.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Transferable Save for project animal Exp. validation
Matthias Rüger, Andreas Martin Seitz, Katja Nuss, Brigitte von Rechenberg, Daniel Seitz et al. Advanced healthcare materials 2023-01-01 10.1002/adhm.202202106
单位: Department of Paediatric Orthopedics and Traumatology, University Children´s Hospital, University of Zurich, Zurich, 8032, Switzerland.; Laboratory for Bone Biomechanics, Institute for Biomechanics, E
通讯: Caitlyn Collins @ Laboratory for Bone Biomechanics, Institute for Biomechanics, ETH Zurich, Zurich, 8093, Switzerland.; Department of Biom [推断]
相关性: 该论文研究了基于烧结钛纤维的各向异性生物金属，通过力学测试和体内骨整合实验验证了其与骨骼匹配的力学性能，但与用户关注的LPBF制造和疲劳性能无关。
边界: Not LPBF fabrication; no fatigue testing; no as-built surface roughness characterization.
动机· 为了减少植入物与骨之间的界面应变，开发基于烧结钛纤维的可调各向异性生物金属。
方法· 采用层叠烧结钛纤维制造六种拓扑结构，进行压缩、三点弯曲和扭转测试，并评估生物相容性和骨整合。
结果· 材料表现出高达50 MPa的压缩屈服强度，各向异性与纤维布局相关，体内骨整合良好。

Motivation· To reduce interface strain in orthopedic implants, a fiber-based biometal with tunable anisotropic mechanical properties is developed.
Method· Layered sintered titanium fibers are used to fabricate six topologies, tested under compression, bending, and torsion, followed by biocompatibility and osseointegration assessment.
Result· The material exhibits compressive yield strengths up to 50 MPa, strong anisotropy, and excellent osseointegration in a sheep model.
Validation· Mechanical testing and in vivo implantation in sheep.

Motivation· To enhance the mechanical properties of unalloyed titanium VT1-0 via selective laser melting for potential medical implant applications.
Method· Samples were fabricated by SLM with varying parameters and subsequently high-temperature annealed; tensile tests and microstructure analysis were conducted.
Result· Ultimate tensile strength of 820 MPa and yield strength of 710 MPa were achieved, double that of conventionally processed material, attributed to martensitic α'-phase formation.
Validation· Mechanical testing and microstructural characterization confirmed the strengthening mechanism and the effect of annealing.

Motivation· To fabricate porous scaffolds via SLM with bone-matching mechanical properties and osteogenic potential.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To meet the demand for lightweight high-strength porous structures fabricated by selective laser melting, this study applies topology optimization to design porous structures and evaluates their mechanical performance.
Method· Three types of topology-optimized porous structures (point, line, and surface) were designed by adjusting porosity and load position, fabricated via SLM with AlSi10Mg, and tested under compression combined with finite element analysis.
Result· The surface topology structure exhibits the most uniform stress distribution and the best mechanical properties, while the Gibson-Ashby model effectively predicts the relationship between porosity and mechanical performance.
Validation· Mechanical testing and finite element simulation validated the mechanical properties and failure mechanisms of the porous structures.

Motivation· This study compared the mechanical properties and cell attachment of Ti6Al4V scaffolds with cubic and diamond unit cells fabricated by SLM.
Method· Two scaffold designs (cubic and diamond) with 80% porosity were fabricated by SLM, coated with biomimetic hydroxyapatite, and characterized by SEM, EDX, XRD, compression testing, and cell culture.
Result· Diamond scaffolds showed higher compressive modulus (0.22 GPa) and better cell attachment compared to cubic scaffolds.
Validation· Validation included morphological characterization (SEM/EDX/XRD), compressive mechanical testing, and in vitro cell attachment assays.

Motivation· To develop a novel helical-shaped 3D-printed titanium cage that improves healing and fusion in cervical vertebral defects compared to traditional cage design.
Method· Helical and traditional titanium cages were implanted in rabbit cervical vertebral defects, and healing was assessed at 1 and 16 weeks via radiography, micro-CT, and histology.
Result· The helical cage group exhibited superior vertebral height restoration, enhanced bone regeneration, and osseointegration relative to the traditional cage group.
Validation· Validation was performed through in vivo rabbit model with radiographic, micro-CT, and histological analyses at 16 weeks post-implantation.

Motivation· The study investigates how porosity influences osseointegration of laser powder bed fused tantalum scaffolds for bone defect repair.
Method· Trabecular tantalum scaffolds with 60%, 70%, and 80% porosity were fabricated via LPBF and evaluated in vitro with rat mesenchymal stem cells and in vivo in a rat femoral defect model.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· This work aims to reduce stress shielding and improve osseointegration by employing functionally graded auxetic porous structures made of a low-modulus β-Ti21S alloy.
Method· Two auxetic designs with different angles were fabricated via laser powder bed fusion, followed by 2D SEM and 3D micro-CT metrological characterization and compression testing.
Result· The stabilized elastic modulus reached approximately 4 GPa, with maximum strut thickness undersizing of -22% and pore undersizing of -19%.
Validation· Compression test results were compared with homogenization and analytical predictions, showing deviations of 4% and 24% for the two designs.

Motivation· To investigate bone ingrowth into 3D-printed porous titanium alloy implants in cortical bone and evaluate the diagnostic consistency of CBCT versus μCT.
Method· Porous implants fabricated by electron beam melting (pore size 600 μm, porosity 50%) were inserted into rabbit tibial diaphysis; bone ingrowth was assessed using CBCT, μCT, and histology.
Result· Mature bone was confirmed in all pores by CBCT and histology, with CBCT showing 85% sensitivity and 84% specificity relative to μCT.
Validation· In vivo rabbit model with histology as ground truth and μCT as reference standard for imaging validation.

动机· 股骨柄应力遮挡是THA术后翻修的主要机械原因，引入负泊松比结构以减少应力遮挡。
方法· 设计九种不同几何轮廓和凹角的拉胀股骨柄，通过有限元模型评估应力遮挡水平。
结果· 拉胀柄比实心柄应力遮挡更小，M型几何和70°凹角设计最优。
验证· 有限元仿真计算骨组织应力分布对比。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Stress shielding is a primary mechanical cause of femoral stem loosening after THA; this study introduces an auxetic lattice structure to reduce it.
Method· Three commercial stem profiles and three re-entrant angles were used to create nine auxetic stems, which were implanted into a finite element femur model to compare stress shielding with solid stems.
Result· Auxetic stems caused less stress shielding than solid stems, with the M-type profile and 70° re-entrant angle being most effective.
Validation· Validation was performed through finite element simulation comparing stress distributions in implanted femurs.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate whether an in-lay collar design improves the mechanical environment for osseointegration in endoprosthetic replacements compared to a traditional on-lay design.
Method· Personalized finite element models derived from CT scans were used to simulate proximal, mid-diaphyseal, and distal femoral reconstructions with both in-lay and on-lay collar configurations under walking loads.
Result· The in-lay collar doubled the contact area, reduced micromotions, and increased predicted bone apposition while decreasing bone resorption in proximal and mid-diaphyseal reconstructions.
Validation· Validation was performed by comparing the intact femur FE model results with established physiological data and ensuring mesh convergence.

Motivation· To develop a bioink that simultaneously achieves good printability and high post-printing cell viability for extrusion-based bioprinting.
Method· A composite hydrogel bioink was formulated by incorporating decellularised extracellular matrix microgels (DMs) into gelatin methacryloyl (GelMA) as a continuous phase, with DMs fabricated via a flow-focusing microfluidic system.
Result· The DM-GelMA hydrogel preserved shear-thinning behavior and mechanical properties, while the DMs provided a protective microenvironment leading to high cell viability after printing, and a modular co-culture system was demonstrated.
Validation· Rheological characterization, 3D printing tests, and cell encapsulation experiments were performed to validate printability and cell viability.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the influence of surface roughness on the low-cycle fatigue behavior of a nickel alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
Method· Low-cycle fatigue tests were conducted on cylindrical solid and hollow samples with three surface finishes: as-built (Ra=4.80 μm), vibratory finished (Ra=1.06 μm), and polished (Ra=0.20 μm).
Result· Surface roughness significantly reduced fatigue durability, with vibratory finished and untreated samples showing 17% lower fatigue life compared to polished samples; fractography revealed that defects from exposure algorithms caused premature failure, especially in hollow samples.
Validation· Fatigue life data, Manson-Coffin and Ramberg-Osgood curves, and fractographic analysis were used to validate the findings.

Motivation· To investigate interfacial defects, microstructure, and microhardness of multi-material parts fabricated by selective laser melting.

动机· 探索3D打印PEEK支架孔径大小如何通过巨噬细胞极化影响骨整合。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate how pore size of 3D-printed PEEK scaffolds modulates macrophage polarization to affect osseointegration.
Method· PEEK scaffolds with pore sizes of 0, 200, and 400 μm were fabricated via 3D printing, and their effects on macrophage polarization, angiogenesis, osteogenesis, and in vivo bone repair were evaluated.
Result· Larger pore size scaffolds induced M1 to M2 macrophage transition, enhanced secretion of osteogenic and angiogenic cytokines, and significantly improved bone volume/total volume ratio and trabecular thickness in a rat bone defect model.
Validation· In vitro co-culture assays with HUVECs and BMSCs, and in vivo bone defect repair in rats with biomechanical testing.

Motivation· This systematic review evaluates the influence of nanoscale surface morphologies on osseointegration of 3D-printed titanium implants.
Method· A systematic literature search following PRISMA guidelines was conducted, with inclusion of in vivo animal studies and risk of bias assessment using SYRCLE's tool.
Result· Evidence suggests that nanostructures such as irregular nano-texture and nanotubes with diameters of 40-105 nm promote osseointegration and vertical bone ingrowth compared to untreated surfaces.
Validation· The review includes nine animal studies with low to unclear risk of bias, but no original experimental validation is performed.

Motivation· To determine how changes in hip-joint center position after THA affect hip-joint contact force magnitude and direction during gait.
Method· Patient-specific musculoskeletal models of 17 patients were created using AnyBody to simulate hip-joint contact forces pre- and post-THA, with correlation analysis between center displacement and force changes.
Result· Post-THA, medial contact force decreased and anterior force increased; mediolateral displacement of the hip-joint center correlated positively with anterior force change and negatively with medial force change.
Validation· The study used patient-specific musculoskeletal simulation and statistical correlation on 17 longitudinal cases.

Motivation· Osseointegrated transfemoral prostheses face risks of aseptic loosening and adverse bone remodeling due to stress shielding, necessitating a standardized preclinical assessment.
Method· This review examines 17 studies on primary stability, stress shielding, and stress concentration, focusing on extraction force, micromotion, and load transfer measurements from in vitro tests and numerical models.
Result· The review identifies a lack of consensus in test setups and model parameters, highlighting the need for defined thresholds and acceptance criteria for failure scenarios.
Validation· As a review, no original experimental or numerical validation is performed; findings are based on literature synthesis.

Motivation· To predict dendrite characteristic size during high-speed solidification in SLM of 316L steel for microstructure control.
Method· A mathematical model based on the Ivantsov paraboloidal crystal approximation and numerical simulation using the two-dimensional Alexandrov-Galenko dendritic growth model with convection.
Result· The solidification velocity and dendrite tip diameter were calculated as functions of macroscopic parameters such as laser speed and melt pool orientation.
Validation· Calculated values were compared with transmission electron microscopy measurements on SLM-fabricated 316L steel samples.

Motivation· The study investigates the effect of hot isostatic pressing temperature on microcrack healing, microstructure evolution, and mechanical properties of selective laser melted GH3536 nickel-based superalloy.

Motivation· To describe the epidemiological profile, indications, and outcomes of hip arthroplasty in a single hospital over a decade.
Method· A descriptive monocentric study retrospectively analysed 95 patients (97 hips) undergoing total hip arthroplasty or hemiarthroplasty from 2010 to 2019.
Result· Femoral neck fracture was the main indication (78%), hemiarthroplasty was used in 78% of cases, and the mean Harris hip score was 75.2 at follow-up.
Validation· Clinical follow-up recorded complications (4 dislocations, 3 infections) and functional outcomes via Harris score.

Motivation· To reduce postoperative subsidence and nonunion in anterior cervical discectomy and fusion by designing a customized intervertebral fusion device.
Method· A non-homogeneous C3-7 cervical spine finite element model was built, and three cage designs (customized, commercial, bone graft) were implanted at C4-5 for comparison.
Result· The customized cage showed lower peak stresses at the cage-bone interface and higher bone graft stresses, indicating reduced risk of stress shielding and subsidence.
Validation· Finite element simulation comparing range of motion and stress distributions under various loading conditions.

Motivation· To investigate whether porous coating on tibial stems in total ankle arthroplasty is associated with increased periprosthetic cyst formation.

Validation· Clinical radiographic follow-up.

Motivation· To design topology-optimized 3D-printed prostheses for periacetabular bone tumor reconstruction to reduce stress shielding.
Method· Patient CT data was used to build FEA models; SIMP topology optimization was performed, and the removed area was replaced with a porous structure.
Result· SED increased significantly after optimization; stress distribution and micromotion below 28 μm showed no significant change; clinical follow-up confirmed osseointegration.
Validation· Pre- and post-operative FEA simulations and preliminary clinical follow-up of two patients.
